# spo_site_design_rights (Resource)

Grants View rights on a site design to principals (Grant/Revoke/Get-SPOSiteDesignRights, CSOM), keyed by the site design GUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spo_site_design_rights" "team" {
  identity   = spo_site_design.team.id
  principals = ["group@contoso.com", "user@contoso.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.
- `principals` (Set of String) User/group principal names granted View rights on the design.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
